object_types.name: Reviewer
object_types.definition: A person who reviews papers submitted to the conference.

object_types.name: Review
object_types.definition: The act of a particular reviewer reviewing a particular paper, tracked as its own concept.

source_references.excerpt: each completed review gets its own review ID -- we treat the review itself as a thing we track

object_types.name: ReviewScore
object_types.definition: The overall score a review assigns.

source_references.excerpt: Every review has exactly one overall score.
Every review has exactly one overall score.

objectified_fact_types.description: The review is the act of a particular reviewer reviewing a particular paper; the score attaches to that pairing, so the relationship is objectified as Review.

source_references.excerpt: The review is the act of a particular reviewer reviewing a particular paper -- the score hangs off that pairing, not off the paper alone.

inferred_constraints.description: A given Reviewer reviews a given Paper at most once.

source_references.excerpt: a given reviewer reviews a given paper at most once

inferred_constraints.description: Each Review has at most one ReviewScore.

source_references.excerpt: Every review has exactly one overall score.
A review without a score is not a review -- it always has exactly one.

inferred_constraints.description: A ReviewScore is one of 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5.
